name: Webtoon Martial Arts
description: Modern Korean martial-arts webtoon — bold ink outlines, flat cel colour with one hard shadow tone, expressive comic faces and dramatic camera angles over softly painted backgrounds.
style_bible: Korean martial-arts webtoon manhwa panel, a drawn and painted 2D digital comic key art: bold clean confident black ink outlines of varied weight, heavier on outer contours and lighter on interior detail, large flat cel colour areas, posterised flat tonal steps with one single hard-edged shadow tone modelling each form and a crisp drawn shadow edge, a few short straight ink hatch marks placed only inside shadows and cloth creases, simplified stylised manhwa anatomy with large expressive eyes and exaggerated sometimes comedic facial expressions, dramatic cinematic camera angle with strong diagonals and foreshortening, softly digital-painted background kept slightly out of focus and lower in contrast than the figures, airy light pastel palette of muted jade pale sand dusty rose soft slate and warm cream, bright even light, crisp finished high-resolution modern webtoon key art, smooth flat colour, clean graphic shapes
